name: The Ritz Carlton, Berlin
positioning: Art Deco-inspired hotel at Potsdamer Platz in central Berlin, officially The Ritz-Carlton, Berlin
best_for: Travelers who want a central Berlin base near Tiergarten and Brandenburg Gate
Guests who enjoy a 1920s Berlin theme, cocktails and German cuisine

facts.text: The hotel is at Potsdamer Platz in Berlin's city center, near Tiergarten and a seven-minute walk from Brandenburg Gate.
Rooms have dramatic floor-to-ceiling headboards that use color and geometric patterns.
POTS serves classics of German cuisine in a modern interpretation.
The Curtain Club has live music on selected days.
The Secret Champagne Garden serves champagne and selected cocktails outdoors in summer.
The Club Lounge is on the 10th floor.
The wellness area has a 24-hour fitness center, a steam room, a Finnish sauna, a lap pool and a relaxation area.
The Ritz Kids Cozy Corner offers children a tipi, curated reading material and a travel diary.
The hotel completed a 40-million-euro renovation in 2019 that reimagined the common areas and rooms.

highlights.text: The life of Marlene Dietrich is honored in the rooms' artwork and minibar design.
Rooms and suites combine Art Deco styled design elements with contemporary touches in homage to Berlin's Golden Age.
The Curtain Club is a cocktail bar serving drinks inspired by the Roaring Twenties.
Remnants of the Berlin Wall stand outside the hotel.
POTS offers more than 200 wines with a focus on German wines.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler says Potsdamer Platz is not scenic but is centrally located.
Spa treatments are performed by a local spa therapist and are available upon request.
Club Lounge access requires an upgraded booking at the Club.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The Ritz-Carlton, Berlin
